sloka: प्रभातायाम् तु शर्वर्याम् पृथु वृक्षा महा यशाः ।उवाच रामः सौमित्रिम् लक्ष्मणम् शुभ लक्षणम् ॥२-५२-१॥
transliteration: prabhātāyām tu śarvaryām pṛthu vṛkṣā mahā yaśāḥ ।uvāca rāmaḥ saumitrim lakṣmaṇam śubha lakṣaṇam ॥2-52-1॥

translations.english: As the night advanced towards dawn, broadchested Rama of great renown said to Lakshmana, son of Sumitra, who had auspicious marks on his body:
